newsitem.title: CHINA: Widespread insect pests hit China wheat crops.
newsitem.headline: Widespread insect pests hit China wheat crops.

text.p: Large areas of China's wheat crop have been affected by pests as it enters a crucial growing stage, the Economic Information Daily said on Wednesday.
Many producing areas have reported pests on wheat crops coupled with damp and weed problems, it quoted the Ministry of Agriculture as saying.
The crops would face threats from dry, hot winds later in the season, it added.
Wheat crops in China's southern provinces have entered the booting and flowering stage while crops in northern regions have entered their jointing stage, the newspaper said.
"It's the crucial stage for the growth of wheat crops," it said.
The ministry urged farm officials across the country to take prompt measures to destroy insects and reduce damage, it said, but gave no further details.
